desc:
WARNING: This experience is not for casual players. Lionhearts is a demanding and challenging experience. Enter at your own risk. 

RECOMMENDED TO PLAY ON PC
THIS GAME REQUIRES MOUSE AND KEYBOARD! 

⚔️ Do you have what it takes to conquer the world... or will you fall short of your destiny? 

🗺️ Lionhearts: Crusade is Roblox's LARGEST faction conquest experience. Enlist in one of our many player run factions and embark on an adventure in the lands and conflicts surrounding the historical THIRD CRUSADE.

👑 Rise through the ranks and seize control of a faction, conquer lands, and dismantle your enemies. In Lionhearts, your destiny will be forged in constant warfare over territory. You will either rise as a conqueror or fall as the conquered.

🛡️  Using in depth MMORPG features, intuitive combat mechanics, and full player freedom... Lionhearts: Crusade strives to offer the most in-depth medieval experience on Roblox!
